name: game-creation-studio
description: Design, prototype, test, and prepare games with source-grounded asset and diagnostic workflows.

interface.longDescription: Focused game design and production methods, with preserved Game Development Studio asset, vendoring, visual diagnosis, and performance methods. Browser implementation routes to the separately installed OpenAI Game Studio. Optional game-dev CLI execution is a separate dependency and is not installed by this package.
defaultPrompt: Design a small playable core loop from this game idea.
Turn this concept into a one-week prototype and playtest.
Diagnose this game capture and telemetry.
